subject.title: fix(ios): restore in-flight runs after reconnect

question: After the release-owned changelog entry is removed, is the Apple run-recovery/session reconciliation risk acceptable for this PR to land?
rationale: The code appears to use the right existing Gateway contract and has strong tests/proof, but it changes high-impact message/session ownership behavior where only a maintainer should accept the residual risk.

options.title: Land after changelog cleanup
options.body: Remove the release-owned changelog entry and proceed with maintainer review/merge using the existing tests and live simulator proof.

options.title: Ask for fresh current-head native proof
options.body: Require another iOS/macOS simulator recovery run on the current head before accepting the session/message-delivery risk.

options.title: Pause for narrower split
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want Apple UI recovery and provider mirror identity changes split into separate landing steps.

recommendation.title: Land after changelog cleanup
recommendation.body: Remove the release-owned changelog entry and proceed with maintainer review/merge using the existing tests and live simulator proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on this PR and adjacent Apple/Android chat recovery work.
